note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the actual inputs.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor and patient conversation).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Once received, I will produce:
- Consult Summary: two-line summary.
- Problem List: up to three issues with timeline, symptoms, systems review, social history, medications, exam findings, and consistent DDx with brief likelihood justifications.
- Medications, Allergies, Past Medical History, Social History, Preventative History.
- Physical Examination details.
- Plan: actions, tests, treatments, referrals, follow-up.
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, any conflict between transcript and DDx, and a brief comment on transcript quality if needed.

Notes:
- I will extract only information present in the transcript or DDx; I will not invent data.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and mark “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON exactly as provided.
